21732.new_name: Open-Crotch Pearl Lace Uniform Set in Three Colors
21732.title_note: Wearable and charming 废词剥；open gear→Open-Crotch；pearl 参数回填；三色属实；48+11=59
21732.desc:
Pearls on lace are an old-money gesture in a genre that usually runs on hardware: instead of chains and straps, the decoration is a row of small round details that catch light quietly and cost the comfort nothing. This uniform-style set applies them to a lace base with an open-crotch cut, which is the genre's other classic move — soft decoration, direct construction.

The uniform reference lives in the collar line and the fitted cut; the open crotch lives where it always does, built into the base so nothing has to come off. Three colors split the palette — black, red and white — with the pearls reading differently on each, most subtle on the black and most decorative on the white.

One size covers the 40–60 kg band with the lace absorbing the range. The pearls are sewn rather than strung, which is the detail that decides whether this decoration survives a wash cycle.

The specifics:

  • Fabric: Lace with pearl detail
  • Style: Uniform-inspired set
  • Key detail: Open-crotch construction
  • Colors: Black, red, white
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Old-money decoration, new-money intentions.
21732.short: Uniform-style lace set with sewn pearl detail and open-crotch construction, in black, red or white, one size for 40–60 kg.
21732.tkd_title: Open-Crotch Pearl Lace Uniform Set, Three Colors | RoseToys
21732.tkd_desc: Pearl-detail lace uniform set with open crotch, in black, red or white, one size for 40-60 kg. Sewn pearls, at RoseToys.

21733.title_note: suspender 吊带误译纠正+Open File（开档）剥（40-75kg 宽松剪裁无确证）；Temptation Tease Free Passion 堆词剥；四色属实
21733.desc:
A uniform-style nightdress that stays sheer is the genre at its most economical: one borrowed cue — the collar, the buttoned-front suggestion — and the fabric does the rest of the persuasion. This piece works exactly that economy in chiffon, with a loose cut through the body that favors comfort over structure and lets the sheerness carry the design.

The fit is one of the wider bands in the category: a single size covering 40–75 kg, honest to the loose cut. Black, red, green and pink versions cover four registers from default to playful, and the uniform cue reads slightly different on each — most convincing on black, most subverted on pink.

As sleepwear it is genuinely that: chiffon this light is a summer-weight nightdress with ambitions. The styling is what those ambitions are, and the loose cut is what makes both readings available.

Fast facts:

  • Fabric: Sheer chiffon
  • Style: Uniform-style nightdress
  • Colors: Black, red, green, pink
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–75 kg (88–165 lbs)

One borrowed cue, four colors, zero structure.
21733.short: Uniform-style sheer chiffon nightdress in a loose comfortable cut, black, red, green or pink, one wide size for 40–75 kg.
21733.tkd_title: Uniform-Style Sheer Nightdress, Four Colors | RoseToys
21733.tkd_desc: Uniform-style sheer chiffon nightdress, loose cut, in black, red, green or pink, one comfortable size for 40-75 kg, at RoseToys.

21734.title_note: Tiktok same style 商标前缀剥；hollow-out/backless/strap nightdress 参数保留；L 单码 79cm/72cm 围度入正文
21734.desc:
Hollow-out lace is really architecture: what is removed defines the design as much as what stays, and the negative space is doing deliberate work. This nightdress builds its pattern that way — a chiffon-and-lace body with cut-out sections across the front, and a backless rear that takes the principle to its conclusion.

The listed measurements are unusually specific for a single-size piece: 79 cm in length and a 72 cm bust, for the 40–60 kg band. Those numbers matter in a hollow-out design because the openings land where the pattern puts them — a few centimeters of drift and a cut-out becomes a gap.

The shoulder straps are designed to untie easily, which is a small feature that says a lot about the design's priorities. Black and gray versions run dark and darker; both photograph as pattern first and garment second.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Chiffon and lace
  • Style: Hollow-out nightdress
  • Key details: Backless, easy-untie shoulder straps
  • Colors: Black, gray
  • Fit: L (length 79 cm, bust 72 cm), recommended 40–60 kg

The holes are the design; the design is the holes.
21734.short: Hollow-out chiffon-and-lace nightdress, backless with easy-untie shoulder straps, black or gray, in a single size L for the 40–60 kg band.
21734.tkd_desc: Hollow-out backless lace nightdress in black or gray, single size L with 79 cm length, for the 40-60 kg band. At RoseToys.

21735.title_note: Tiktok same style 商标前缀剥；Butterfly Knot→Butterfly-Bow；shirt-style 参数入正文；双色属实
21735.desc:
A butterfly bow at the front is the one concession to cute that sheer mesh ever needs: it gives the fabric a focal point, a bit of structure, and a joke that lands without narration. This nightdress mounts the bow at the bust of a chiffon mesh body and otherwise stays out of its own way.

The cut borrows from shirt styling — a collar suggestion, a front line, sleeves that remember they are sleeves — which is what keeps the piece readable as sleepwear rather than as a costume. The mesh runs sheer and light, and the whole thing packs down to the size of the bow.

Black and white versions run the standard two directions. A single graded size covers 40–75 kg, honest to the loose shirt-style cut, and the cold wash takes care of the rest.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Chiffon mesh
  • Style: Shirt-style nightdress with butterfly bow
  • Colors: Black, white
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–75 kg (88–165 lbs)

One bow, one job, done.
21735.short: Shirt-style chiffon mesh nightdress with a butterfly bow at the bust, black or white, one wide size for 40–75 kg.

21766.desc:
Butterflies on crotchless lace are the genre's favorite contradiction, and the pairing survives because each half does its job without negotiating: the motif makes the fabric pretty, the cut makes the garment candid. This teddy runs both — a butterfly-pattern lace body in a single piece, with the open construction the name states plainly.

The fabric is a polyester-satin blend, which gives the lace a faint sheen that flat mesh lacks, and the pattern sits on top of it at regular intervals. Black, white and red versions behave as expected — the red being the one that commits fully to the contradiction.

One size covers 40–70 kg, which the stretch of the satin blend handles honestly. As a gift it reads thoughtful; as a self-purchase it reads decisive; either way the listing does not oversell what the name already says.

What you are getting:

  • Fabric: Polyester-satin with butterfly lace
  • Style: Crotchless one-piece teddy
  • Colors: Black, white, red
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–70 kg (88–154 lbs)

Pretty on the surface, plain-spoken underneath.
21766.short: Crotchless one-piece teddy in butterfly-pattern polyester-satin lace, in black, white or red, one generous stretch size for 40–70 kg wearers.
21766.tkd_desc: Butterfly lace crotchless teddy in polyester-satin, black, white or red, one size for 40-70 kg. Sheen finish, at RoseToys.

21767.title_note: spicy cut-out opening 堆词收敛；open gear→Open-Crotch；三色属实
21767.desc:
Cut-outs and an open crotch on the same jumpsuit is design by subtraction, twice over: first the pattern removes fabric where it wants attention, then the construction removes the crotch for reasons the category has never felt obliged to explain. This piece commits to both subtractions on a lace base and stops there — no hardware, no strapping, nothing added back.

The lace runs stretchy enough to hold the cut-out edges flat, which is the entire engineering requirement of the style. Black, white and red versions of the same pattern give the subtraction three temperatures, with the white reading as the most candid of the three — pale fabric makes absence visible.

One size covers the 40–60 kg band. The jumpsuit pulls on and stays where the pattern puts it, and the two openings do the rest of the talking.

Fast facts:

  • Fabric: Stretch lace
  • Style: One-piece jumpsuit
  • Key details: All-over cut-outs, open crotch
  • Colors: Black, white, red
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Subtracted twice, added nothing.
21767.short: One-piece stretch lace jumpsuit with all-over cut-outs and open-crotch construction, black, white or red, in one size for the 40–60 kg band.
21767.tkd_desc: Cut-out open-crotch lace jumpsuit in black, white or red, one comfortable size for 40-60 kg. Design by subtraction, at RoseToys.

21768.new_name: Front-Slit Lace Nightdress in Three Colors
21768.title_note: temptation 堆词剥；front slit 上标题；L/2XL 双码+三色属实；wine red 属实
21768.desc:
A slit at the front rather than the side changes a nightdress's walk entirely: the opening faces forward, so every step is the reveal rather than every turn. This lace nightdress is cut around that single decision — a front slit running up from the hem, with the rest of the design kept quiet so the slit keeps the stage.

The fabric is a polyester lace with a stable stretch, and the sizing is one of the more useful arrangements in the category: L for 40–60 kg and 2XL for 65–80 kg, two honest bands rather than one optimistic one. Three colors — black, white and wine red — with the wine red being the shade that makes the front slit look most intentional.

As sleepwear it is light and unhindered; the slit is generous but the lace holds its line. As lingerie it is a one-move piece: the design is complete at the first step.

The breakdown:

  • Fabric: Polyester lace
  • Style: Front-slit nightdress
  • Colors: Black, white, wine red
  • Sizes: L (40–60 kg / 88–132 lbs), 2XL (65–80 kg / 143–176 lbs)

The slit faces the audience, where it belongs.
21768.short: Front-slit polyester lace nightdress in black, white or wine red, two honest sizes L and 2XL covering the 40–80 kg range.

21809.title_note: Silky swimcloth（泳衣料直译）剥；double-ended zipper→Two-Way-Zip；short sleeve+body-bound 参数回填
21809.desc:
A two-way zip is the most honest fastening in lingerie: it opens from either end, which means the wearer decides how much and from where, and the mechanism does not editorialize. This jumpsuit is built around exactly that — a full front zip that runs both directions, in a short-sleeve body-bound cut.

The fabric is a silky polyester with the smooth, swimwear-adjacent hand that this style runs on: it slides over skin, holds a fitted line without padding the body, and washes without a story. The body-bound cut means the jumpsuit maps rather than drapes — this is the fitted version of the genre, and the zip is how anyone gets into it.

One size covers the 40–60 kg band, and black is the only color, which at this gloss level is the correct number of colors.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Silky stretch polyester
  • Style: Short-sleeve fitted jumpsuit
  • Key detail: Full two-way front zip
  • Color: Black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

One zip, two directions, every decision yours.
21809.short: Short-sleeve fitted jumpsuit in silky stretch polyester with a full two-way front zip, in black, one size for 40–60 kg.
21809.tkd_desc: Short-sleeve fitted jumpsuit in silky black polyester with a two-way front zip, one comfortable size for 40-60 kg, at RoseToys.

21815.title_note: Big ribbon gift uniform→gift-wrap 语境自然化；Christmas 参数回填；clothing only 单件属实
21815.desc:
Christmas costume that wraps the wearer as the gift is the genre's oldest joke and still its best, because the joke is also the function: the bow is the wrapping, the wearer is the present, and the unwrapping is built into the design. This piece plays it straight — a big red bow at the front of a Christmas-styled costume piece, sized to be unmistakable.

The costume is a single clothing piece rather than a set, which suits the joke: a gift that comes with accessories is a hamper, and nobody wants to unwrap a hamper. Red throughout, with the bow doing nearly all of the visual work and the costume base staying deliberately plain.

One size covers the 40–60 kg band. It packs flat for travel, which matters for a seasonal piece that spends fifty weeks a year in storage, and it emerges from the drawer each December looking exactly as committed as it did the first year.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Polyester
  • Style: Christmas gift-wrap costume
  • Key detail: Oversized front bow
  • Color: Red
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

The wrapping is the gift; the gift is the wearer.
21815.short: Christmas gift-wrap costume in red polyester with an oversized front bow, one size for 40–60 kg, packs flat for storage.
21815.tkd_desc: Red Christmas gift-wrap costume with an oversized front bow, one comfortable size for 40-60 kg. The classic joke, from RoseToys.

21819.title_note: seduction 堆词剥；mesh+lace 双材质属实保留；单色黑
21819.desc:
Plain black lace is the workhorse finish of the jumpsuit drawer: no color to date it, no pattern to clash with anything, and nothing to distract from the two things that matter — the mesh and the cut. This jumpsuit is exactly those two things: a sheer black mesh-lace body in a one-piece cut, closed with nothing but the stretch.

Mesh and lace together give the fabric two registers at once: the mesh provides the sheer ground, the lace provides the pattern on it. From a distance it reads as texture; at conversation range it reads as very little, which is the point.

One size covers the standard weight band, and the stretch does the fitting. There is no fastening inventory at all — the jumpsuit pulls on, maps the body, and gets on with its evening.

The specifics:

  • Fabric: Sheer mesh lace
  • Style: One-piece jumpsuit
  • Color: Black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Black, sheer, finished — the baseline done properly.
21819.short: One-piece black jumpsuit in sheer mesh lace with no fastenings at all, stretch doing the fitting, one size for 40–60 kg.
21819.tkd_desc: Sheer mesh lace jumpsuit in black, one-piece pull-on with no fastenings, one comfortable size for 40-60 kg. Sold at RoseToys.
